cell.label: Operative management. If patient is hemodynamically stable, start with laparoscopic reduction. Consider intraoperative use of air or saline enema to facilitate reduction. Consider removing the appendix in setting of inflammation or ischemia.
4 hours observation to ensure symptoms resolved and tolerating oral regimen
Repeat enema if patient is stable, without peritonitis; repeat up to 4 attempts.
Hospital admission (poor oral intake, vomiting, lethargy, fever, tachycardia, and/or pain; difficulty returning to ED after discharge).
